note: Plumas NF campground on Antelope Lake, a remote reservoir about 30 mi NE of Taylorsville, in shady pine and fir woods on a point between the lake's west arm and its open water; a car-top boat launch is in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + imagery/3DEP read. $36 every season; 83 family sites (FS says 87) + 1 group, paved back-ins, all but one 23 ft+; no hookups; vault toilets; dump closed indefinitely; rec.gov, 32 FCFS sites and all FCFS after Aug 31; season ~05-23..09-28 (2026: 05-22..09-27); open. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (nearest 'Lakefront'-tagged sites 40-60 m back through continuous pine canopy). Pin fine. Water conflict FS vs rec.gov.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (lakefront -> lakeview): rec.gov tags 19 sites 'Lakefront' (025-038 on the west arm; 060-080 on the east side) and says 'several of them adjacent to the lake, providing views of the lake'; the FS page says 'several lake-front sites'. Measured with all 85 catalog positions on Esri imagery and 3DEP: the nearest west-arm sites 033 (40.19129,-120.61557), 035 and 036 (40.19087,-120.61506) are ~40-45 m from the imagery waterline and ~55-60 m from the ~1524.6 m (5,002 ft) contour, through a continuous pine band ~25-30 m deep before an open shoreline strip; the east-side sites 066-072 (e.g. 070 at 40.19143,-120.61213) sit ~45 m inside a dense pine stand from the treeline and ~60-70 m from that contour, with drawn-down lakebed beyond. rec.gov tags every site 'Shade Full'. The bank is gentle (pads ~2.5-3 m above full pool over 55-70 m), but no named site is within ~50 m over open ground, so under the canopy rule this is a view. Suggested evidence: 'rec.gov 232913 Lakefront tags on 19 sites + its own wording "adjacent to the lake, providing views of the lake"; Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: nearest sites 033/035/036 (west arm) ~40-45 m to the waterline / ~55-60 m to the 5,002-ft contour through a 25-30 m pine band, east sites 066-072 ~60-70 m through dense pines; all sites Shade Full -> lakeview (filtered through trees).'
WATER CONFLICT: the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; recreation.gov's facility text says 'vault toilets and drinking water'. potable_water not written.
PEOPLE CONFLICT: FS page '6 people per campsite'; rec.gov catalog 'Max Num of People 8' on every site. Not written.

EXTRA VEHICLE CONFLICT: FS '2 vehicles per campsite' and a rec.gov notice that the second vehicle pays the posted daily rate, against rec.gov's facility text 'extra vehicles can be parked in nearby overflow parking at no extra charge'. Amount not posted online; not written beyond the fees note.
COUNT: stored 87 (FS page) -> 83 family sites in the rec.gov catalog (85 incl. one group site and one non-reservable electric site, likely the host's).
